sentences.text: The applicant has filed the said application for producing the video and audio recording relating to chat of the applicant with the prosecutrix.
The trial Court has rejected the said application on the ground that at the stage of recording of the prosecution witnesses, the same would not be required to be taken on record.
The Court has granted liberty to the applicant to adduce the said evidence at the time of the defence.
I do not find any illegality in the order.
It is clarified that the applicant shall be permitted to adduce the aforesaid evidence at the stage of defence evidence.
With the aforesaid, the petition under Section 482 of Cr.P.C. is disposed off.
